supersedesHostedLifecycleFailure.failure: The source-bound candidate rendered normally, but its service worker remained without an active registration or controller while ynx-wallet-web-v8 and ynx-wallet-web-v11 caches coexisted.

source.rootCause: The worker activate handler awaited client.navigate after clients.claim. Navigation waited for activation while activation waited for navigation, leaving the worker activating and the page uncontrolled.
source.repair: The worker now proves a complete v11 integrity cache before activation, claims clients without navigating them, and deletes obsolete caches only after integrity is ready. The page performs at most one marker-bound reload and requires an activated v11 worker, a v11 controller, and a stable v11-only cache before declaring PWA ready.

runtimeEvidence.class: Playwright bundled Chromium-compatible persistent same-origin profile; not branded Chrome/Edge and not an installed PWA

artifacts.name: ynx-wallet-web-pwa-0.1.0.zip
artifacts.minimumOS: modern browser with Service Worker and Web Crypto support

singleExecutableBlocker.request: Issue one wholly new bounded hosted Chromium immutable-candidate preflight lease for the exact candidate and current owner-branch parent.
singleExecutableBlocker.requiredEvidence: Four HTTP 200 raw resources with complete headers/bodies/bytes/SHA and exact source identity; build-identity.json and sw.js Cache-Control contain no-store; persistent hosted Chromium seeded with only the same-origin v8 cache reaches activated v11 registration, v11 controller, v11-only cache after at most one product-controlled reload, then remains v11-only after a full browser process close and second launch; normal English Wallet UI, one tab, stable URL, no blank page, console0, no integrity error, DOM/screenshots/registration/cache/controller logs.
singleExecutableBlocker.artifactIsolation: Use a new empty RUNNER_TEMP output directory and upload only files created by that run.
singleExecutableBlocker.forbidden: No retry, dispatch, secrets, inputs, dynamic URL, alias, product source/UI/deployment, extension install, account, signing or transaction action.
